## Administrative Experience

```{r}
#| label: admin-pdf
#| output: asis

# Filter for highlighted administrative roles
admin_data <- cv_data$admin %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE) %>%
  arrange(display_order)

# Group by institution and role
admin_grouped <- admin_data %>%
  group_by(institution, title) %>%
  summarise(
    details = list(detail),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Output LaTeX formatted content
for (i in 1:nrow(admin_grouped)) {
  cat("\\textbf{", escape_latex(admin_grouped$title[i]), "}\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("\\textit{", escape_latex(admin_grouped$institution[i]), "}\n\n", sep = "")
  
  # Add bullet points
  cat("\\begin{itemize}\n")
  for (detail in admin_grouped$details[[i]]) {
    cat("\\item ", escape_latex(detail), "\n", sep = "")
  }
  cat("\\end{itemize}\n\n")
  
  # Add spacing between entries
  if (i < nrow(admin_grouped)) {
    cat("\\vspace{2mm}\n\n")
  }
}
```
